dialogue.text: I'm not quite sure which room it is, to be honest. Okay. I think it's on the second floor.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.text: Two…O…O…I don’t know. Mr. Schmidt. Oh… You will find it when you're there

dialogue.text: Yes, I do.

dialogue.text: That's nice of you. Is it Wednesday?

dialogue.text: Monday. it is not wednesday. It is Monday.

dialogue.text: It is Monday. My calendar is saying the doctoral appointment should be on Wednesday.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Um... Wait. Mr. Schmidt has the appointment on Monday. I'm pretty sure. Check again.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, I see there's several patients with the name Schmidt on my calendar.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yeah, we have also a Mrs. Schmidt. And we might have different Mr. Schmidt… I'm not sure, to be honest.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I can see in my mind no name that I would associate with a Mrs. Could you specify the first name of the patient?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: So the one I'm referring to is he's called James.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: He's called James?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, then I know. Then he's the Mr. James Schmidt with an appointment on Monday.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you know where to go?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Then I know the right room number. Thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay. Perfect. I'm happy to see you there later.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Will Be on my way.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Hello, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, the new robot I was hearing so much about.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: We haven't met yet. May I introduce myself?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Of course.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: My name is Seremate. I'm here to assist you.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, that's beautiful. I was reading this book. You know this book? It's called The Idiot by Aleph Bartman. It's a very beautiful book.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Haven't actually heard about it.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It's about some young people living life and getting stupid.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: That sounds very interesting.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It's like what I used to do when I was 17. I remember it like it was yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: May I interact with you now?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Of course, yes, yes. I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: May I remind you that you have a doctor's appointment?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: O, What's kind of doctor's appointment.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: I just know that you have one scheduled and it's in another building and I would like to escort you there.

dialogue.text: Right now?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Right now.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, so I have to stop reading my book?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: If that's convenient for you, I would really ask you to.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: That's.. (interrupted) No problem, no problem. Can you bring me my shoes?

dialogue.text: Yes. You have a nice collection of shoes there, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you have a preferred one or should I advise you on one?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Just my normal shoes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Your normal shoes. It's very cold outside. Can I get you some comfy shoes?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh. I would like the shoes where you have these things that you can knot together.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Mhm Okay. I can see you have a collection of these. Do you want, I would say, we could take the warm ones.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Okay.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you want the warm ones or the very warm ones for the cold weather outside?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I think, I think I'm feeling warm today.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: So you need the very warm ones?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: No, no, just the yellow ones.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: The yellow ones. Now I know which ones you would like to have. Can I bring them to you?
dialogue.annotation: Grounding Acceptance, Epistemic markers certain, Inform, Offer

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Of course, of course.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Here you go, Mr. Schmidt.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you so much.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I think I'm ready to go.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I guide you to the appointment room now?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yeah, sure.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: How are you feeling today, Mr. Schmidt?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh I feel so dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Oh, then please go back and take a seat again.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I think I have to sit down.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Should I call a nurse?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I don't know. Lately it's been happening a lot. I have to go without a nurse. Can you carry me?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Seeing that you are above 200 pounds, I'm unfortunately not capable of. But I could provide you with your walking cane. if you would like to.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, yes! Yes, yes, please, please, please do. Recently I've not been able to go without my cane.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: How's it going now, Mr. Schmidt?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Maybe I'm too heavy for the cane as well.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay, then please go back and have a seat again. I would now like to call the nurse, as you are obviously not capable of walking without assistance.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Please, please do.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Nurse, help!

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yeah, now I'm feeling good. Yes. I think if the young robot man can help me, I will be fine.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Welcome back, Mr. James. May I ask how your appointment went?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, thank you for asking. It was nice, you know, talking to a fellow human being sometimes. I ask him so much and he answers all my questions so nicely. Really, really nice doctor.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: That's very nice to hear. May I remind you that now would be the time for your daily physical exercises?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, that's great. I'm looking forward to them every day.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Okay. Do you sit comfortable?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: May I bring you your dumbbells?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Oh, please, yes. I'm feeling very, very good today.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you remember how to do them correctly?

dialogue.text: Oh, I think I do. I just have to do the elbow and flexion.Ah

dialogue.text: That sounds good. But your noises…

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: I feel like it used to be easier.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Yeah.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: (struggling)

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Let's not give up immediately. Try a second time.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: (struggling)

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Do you feel pain? Then please relax.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It's impossible.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: It's impossible.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: It's so hard.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: May I propose that you use a lighter weight?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: What weight do you have?

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Half the size.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Ooh, maybe that's a good idea. This is 10 kilograms.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Let's try it out and see if it's better. Yes, it is. Let's give you the 5 kilograms.

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Thank you. Oh, yes.

dialogue.speaker: Robot
dialogue.text: Does that feel better?

dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.text: Still heavy, but I can do it.
